📖 How to use

  1. Type integers separated by commas, spaces or new lines.
  2. Press Calculate.
  3. Read the GCF and LCM plus how many numbers were used.
  4. Edit the list any time — results update on demand.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are GCF and LCM computed?

With Euclid's algorithm applied pairwise across the list: GCF(a,b,c) = GCF(GCF(a,b),c), and LCM uses the identity LCM(a,b) = |a×b| ÷ GCF(a,b).

How are negative numbers and zeros handled?

Signs are ignored — both are computed on absolute values. Zeros are skipped for GCF; a zero in the list makes the LCM zero.

How many numbers can I enter?

Yes, up to 100 integers. Very large values may lose precision because the LCM is computed in floating point.
